# Barcitinib Oral

# Patients with eGFR >/= 60 ml/min/1.73 m2:

[Baricitinib 4 mg PO qday for 14 days or until discharge \(COVID-19\) \($$$\) R](psjzid-baricitinib-eua-covid-4mg-po-qday-x14days)

[Baricitinib 4 mg NG qday for 14 days or until discharge \(COVID-19\) \($$$\) R](orz-set-abx-baricitinib-ng-4mg-administration-instructions)

[Baricitinib 4 mg G Tube qday for 14 days or until discharge \(COVID-19\)](orz-set-abx-baricitinib-gtube-4mg-admin-instructions)

($$$) [R]

# Patients with eGFR 30-59 ml/min/1.73 m2:

[Baricitinib 2 mg PO qday for 14 days or until discharge \(COVID-19\) \($$\) R](psjzid-baricitinib-eua-covid-2mg-po-qday-x14days)

[Baricitinib 2 mg NG qday for 14 days or until discharge \(COVID-19\) \($$\) R](orz-set-abx-baricitinib-ng-2mg-administration-instructions)

[Baricitinib 2 mg G Tube qday for 14 days or until discharge \(COVID-19\)](orz-set-abx-baricitinib-gtube-2mg-admin-instructions)

($$) [R]

# Patients with eGFR 15-29 ml/min/1.73 m2:

[Baricitinib 1 mg PO qday for 14 days or until discharge \(COVID-19\) \($$\) R](psjzid-baricitinib-eua-covid-1mg-po-qday-x14days)

[Baricitinib 1 mg NG qday for 14 days or until discharge \(COVID-19\) \($$\) R](orz-set-abx-baricitinib-ng-1mg-administration-instructions)

[Baricitinib 1 mg G Tube qday for 14 days or until discharge \(COVID-19\)](orz-set-abx-baricitinib-gtube-1mg-admin-instructions)

($$) [R]

# Patients with an eGFR < 15ml/min/1.73 m2 or those on dialysis:

Baricitinib is NOT recommended
